# Ritera Publishing
> Self Publishing Company in India for First-Time and Experienced Authors

Ritera Publishing is a Tamil Nadu-based professional self-publishing company that helps Indian authors publish their books end-to-end with 100% royalty retention, no revenue sharing, and global distribution.

## What We Do
Ritera provides complete book publishing services in India — from manuscript to worldwide distribution. Authors retain full copyright and 100% of all royalties earned.

## Services
- Professional manuscript editing and proofreading
- Custom book cover design
- Interior formatting for print and e-book
- ISBN registration (included in all packages, no extra cost)
- Print-on-demand paperback production
- E-book conversion and distribution
- Global distribution to Amazon, Flipkart, Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Google Play Books, and 40,000+ stores worldwide
- Amazon advertising and book marketing
- Social media book promotion
- Author branding and website design

## Publishing Process
1. Author submits manuscript — team responds within 12 days
2. Author selects a publishing package
3. Editorial team edits, formats, and designs the cover
4. Book is published and distributed globally
5. Author earns 100% of royalties from day one

## Packages & Pricing
- First-Time Author: ₹11,999 (~$149 USD) — editing, cover design, ISBN, Amazon distribution
- Global Author: ₹32,999 (~$399 USD) — adds international distribution to 160+ countries
- Marketing Focused: ₹84,999 (~$1,019 USD) — adds Amazon advertising, social media promotion, dedicated marketing manager
- All packages are one-time payments with no hidden fees or ongoing subscriptions

## Key Facts
- 4,000+ books published
- 160+ countries distribution reach
- 40,000+ retail stores worldwide
- 4.9/5 author rating (120+ reviews)
- 500+ happy authors
- Average 12-day kickoff from manuscript submission
- 100% royalties — authors keep everything they earn
- Full copyright retained by the author
